scope: Optional SANDBOX position research; no execution input or automatic promotion
identity: Reviewed primary-network mapping only; exact address and network, no fuzzy ticker search
pool_identity: Uniswap v4 uses a validated bytes32 pool ID, never a token or contract address; token identity validation remains strict
unknown_identity: Persist UNKNOWN in research run; never block or approve a trade
mapping_expiry: 30 days for initial reviewed seeds; expired or revoked mappings degrade to UNKNOWN
selection: Current bound SANDBOX accounts, actually filled active residual positions; public symbols only
empty_positions: IDLE; no automatic network work or invented positions
smoke_scope: Explicitly marked Q/AKE research cases, not current holdings

failures.provider: No immediate retries; persistent provider-only exponential cooldown, respecting bounded Retry-After
failures.research_storage: Do not request external data if circuit/registry cannot be read; stop further requests after failed persistence
failures.low_disk: Skip collection below 10 GiB free; bounded research retention remains attempted
failures.worker_hang: Independent systemd cgroup is killed after 75s; no trading service dependency or restart action
failures.partial_evidence: Normal partial coverage is not an operational outage and sends no Telegram notification
failures.trading: Opening, closing and native protection never call this sidecar or wait on its state

limits_of_inference: Buy/sell USD windows are provider aggregates, not independently reconstructed individual swaps.
Pool search is a top-three subset on one network, with no provider update timestamp; do not assume full coverage or verified freshness.
USD liquidity or price changes are not evidence of LP removal or participant intention.
Actual swap logs, LP events, exchange-wallet ownership/flows, block finality and reorg proof remain UNKNOWN.
No local file is used for live counters, state, mappings or observations; reviewed JSON is a deployment seed only.
Shared CPU, disk and PostgreSQL costs are bounded, not literally zero.
